Dialogs.Dialog: Come to think of it, that guy on loan from head office seems down lately.
Anegasaki
Huh, the one with the long sideburns？
Yes, yes, the one with weirdly long sideburns. I wonder what happened.
Apparently he got dumped by his girlfriend.
I see.
And apparently it was a pretty brutal dumping, so he can't get over the shock.
So he can't really focus on work, either.
I see...
So next time you're on the same shift, maybe you should back him up.
I see... okay, I'll keep an eye out.
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, did you see Mr. Sideburns, the guy on loan from head office？
I did. It surprised me.
To think he shaved off those long sideburns so cleanly...
At first I didn't even recognize him. I thought he was a new hire.
I don't think he changed that much...
But what changed his mind, I wonder？
I happened to overhear him talking. He went for a clean cut to get over his heartbreak.
Huh.
"Shaving my sideburns, I feel reborn as a new me"... he said, but it sounded a bit desperate.
So the manager encouraged him, saying that by the time his sideburns grow back, his broken heart will have healed. And Mr. Sideburns went, "Yeah, true."
So he's growing them back after all...
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, I haven't seen "Mr. Napoli" at the restaurant lately.
Mr. Napoli？
Ah, you don't know？ There's a regular who always orders the Napolitan every single day, right？
Ah, him. Come to think of it, I haven't seen him lately...
Right. I wonder if he started going to another restaurant？
Maybe he just got sick of Napolitan？
No, that's definitely not it. His passion for Napolitan is real.
He's been eating our Napolitan for over a year straight, you know？ Do you think he'd get sick of it now？
Over a year... that's definitely past the point of getting sick of it...
Right？ Hmm, I wonder what happened...？
Anegasaki
Oh right, listen. The other day, Mr. Napoli finally came back to Dixie's.
Ah. The customer who kept eating nothing but Napolitan...
Yes, and what do you think he ordered？
Wasn't it Napolitan？
Well... it was carbonara.
Then, wasn't it someone else？
No. Everyone remembered his face well, so it's definitely him.
Huh... so his tastes changed. He's human, things like that happen.
...When you say that, it makes me really anxious... do people get bored after all？
W-we're talking about food...
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, have you memorized the new menu properly？
Menu... at Dixie's？
Geez... did you forget I told you that you have to memorize it？
Now that you mention it...
At the very least, hurry up and memorize what's been removed. Otherwise, when a customer orders it, you'll be slow to respond, right？
But when I enter it in the machine, I'll know it's not there...
No good. At times like that, you think you entered it wrong and keep redoing it, right？
Meaning I'd keep the customer waiting for nothing？
Well done. Fumbling around affects the restaurant's reputation, okay？
Yeah... that's bad, I'd better hurry and memorize it...
Anegasaki
It's been a while since Dixie's changed its menu... you've memorized it by now, right？
Yeah, of course.
Hehe. That's the spirit. As your former trainer, I can't help keeping an eye on your growth.
But there's always something new to learn... isn't Dixie's expecting too much from part-timers？
Hmm, is it？ I don't think so...
I wonder if other part-time jobs are like this too？
I wonder？ But isn't that what working for pay is about？
If it's like this for a part-time job, what'll it be like when I'm working for real...
Hehe. I'm planning on us both working for a while, so a job with low pay is fine, you know？
Well, that's good...
Hm？ ...Us both working？
Anegasaki
Oh right. The manager said he wants you to handle the next new hire.
So that means I'm the trainer!?
Hehe. Personally, I'm a little worried？
Me too...
Worried after all？
Well... I'm not confident I can teach as well as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ taught me...
You'll be fine. I was nervous at first too.
You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yes. So... oh, I know. Shall I be the trainer's trainer？
Yes, please.
Anegasaki
Seems like training the new guy is going pretty well.
It's all thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I guess？
Really？ I don't think I did much...
I'm doing it while remembering all sorts of things from when you taught me... you know.
Hehe. So that means... you're teaching him hands-on？
W-was I like that？
Don't you remember？ Like when I taught you how to use the dishwasher...
The new guy's a guy, so getting up close and hands-on is...
...If it were a girl, would you have done it？
I wouldn't, and I couldn't. I already have ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Mm, good answer.
Oh right. Remember when a foreign customer came the other day？
Anegasaki
Hmm, when？ We have regular foreign customers too...
Really？
Yes. They don't stand out much, but there are customers who come with their families a few times a month.
Huh, Dixie's is surprisingly international.
Hehe. So, what happened？
Well. At times like that, I wondered if I should respond in English if I can. Like "Welcome."
I wonder？ They're not necessarily from an English-speaking country...
Right... hmm, that customer spoke Japanese really well...
You've started paying attention to things like that... hehe, that makes me a little happy.
Anegasaki
Ah, right. Apparently at restaurants, just "Hello" is fine.
What's that？
How you'd say "irasshaimase" in English.
Ah... about the foreign customer I mentioned before？ You looked it up for me.
But isn't it usually "May I help you？"
Yes, but at restaurants it's lighter, just a greeting, apparently. Like "Good afternoon."
Really...？
But you know, I think "irasshaimase" in Japanese is best after all.
Really？
It might be rude, like saying "you don't understand Japanese, do you？" Lots of them do understand Japanese.
I see.
And if you use half-baked English and they think you're a staffer who speaks English, that'd be a problem, right？
True...
Anegasaki
...Hehe.
What's wrong？
No. I was just remembering something from work. You know, when that customer with kids came...
That was, how do I put it.
Those kids kept following you around and copying you.
My moves must've been really funny... haah.
Hehe. Don't be down. It means the kids liked you, right？
You think？
I think someone kids like is way more wonderful than someone kids dislike.
When you put it that way... hmm, maybe it wasn't so bad？
...Pfft.
Anegasaki
What？ Suddenly laughing...
Sorry. I was remembering something from work, you know, that boy who wouldn't leave ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ alone.
Ahh... that boy was so cute.
Yeah. His mom was in the restroom changing the baby's diaper.
But why did that boy grab ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s skirt and not let go？
Hehe. Boys want to be spoiled by their moms, right？
So... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looked like his mom？
Geez... a big sister, maybe, but a mom, no way.
Haha, sorry.
Anegasaki
Ah, have you heard Dixie's is opening a new store？
No, first I've heard. Where？
Well, apparently it's going to be right near our store.
That means... won't it compete with ours？
You know, our store has good sales, and enough staff that we can change shifts freely, right？
But we don't have enough people to staff another store... I guess they'll hire new people, but...
I think so too, but the head office seems keen on it... the manager seems troubled.
I see... and the manager works so hard...
It might be a problem for the company... but I hope the new store plan falls through...
Yeah, really...
Anegasaki
Remember there was talk about a new store maybe opening near ours？
Could it be...
It's officially been canceled.
Yes！ The manager can relax now.
More than anything, we can relax too.
Why？
Huh, we might have been split up between the two stores. ...Didn't you notice？
Yeah...
Geez, and I was so worried...
Sorry... I couldn't even imagine not being with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Ah... geez, so cute...
Anegasaki
Come to think of it... don't you think junior high girls have been coming to Dixie's a lot lately？
Now that you mention it... seems like they're on their way home from cram school, kind of.
...Ugh.
What's wrong？
Did you notice they're there for you？
...No way...
It can't be helped. You're cool, and cute, and a little spacey, but you seem like you'd come through when it counts...
Well...
I'm really anxious... I trust you, but still... you know？
It's fine. I only have eyes for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
...Yes. I know. But remember that I'm just a little anxious, okay？
Anegasaki
By the way... did they confess to you？
Confessed？
You know... the junior high girls who started coming to the restaurant.
Ah, those girls... but they haven't been coming lately, right？
Right... why is that？
Because I told them I'm dating ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I guess？
...You told them.
Well, they asked if I was seeing anyone... was that a bother？
No. Just... um... did you properly say I'm your girlfriend？
Of course I did.
...Okay. Then you're forgiven.
Hehe, if that's the reason, I'd forgive anything. Hehe.
Come to think of it, the manager said Dixie's uniforms might change...
Anegasaki
Yes, apparently... but they probably won't, I think？
Really？
Could it be you haven't seen the design sketches for the new uniforms yet？
I only heard about it from the manager... huh, there are sketches already.
The men's are fine. They're not that different from now.
...Could it be the women's are wild？
Hmm... if you were the only one I'd show it to, I might consider it...
So that means...
Hehe. If you really insist, maybe I'll vote in favor？
Anegasaki
Ah, right. Did you hear Dixie's new uniforms got scrapped？
Of course. Because I objected.
Hehe... so you got to see the sketches.
No matter what, a uniform with that little fabric... it wouldn't be a family restaurant anymore.
Actually, I have a sample. I could show you at my place now？
Just kiiidding. Hehe. If you take it that seriously, I might make one myself, you know？
Well, as your boyfriend, if no one else sees...
Geez... I really was joking, okay？
S-Sorry... Hahaha...
Anegasaki
Has working at Dixie's become second nature by now？
Yeah. But I try to stay on my toes. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ warned me so many times, after all.
Hehe, as expected of our most promising up-and-comer.
Up-and-comer...
The manager says so too, you know？ If you were a college student job hunting, he'd hire you full-time for sure.
That's flattery. I'm still...
No, even to me you seem dependable, you know？ Come on, have more confidence.
...You think so？
Hehe. That modest side of you is one reason you score so high, you know？
I think it's all thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ teaching me, though...
Come to think of it... you know how you said the manager thinks highly of me？
Anegasaki
Yes. Did he say something？
The manager praised ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ too. Said you're really dependable.
You're just saying that... you made him say it, didn't you？
No way. He said ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ takes care of all the part-timers single-handedly, so it's a big help.
I see... but for me, I care more about how you rate me than how the manager does... I guess？
What？
Nothing. Our manager's a smooth talker, don't you think？
Yeah. But I was happy to hear ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ praised.
You're my teacher, after all.
...Geez.
Anegasaki
Ah, Kuro-chan... no, it can't be. Right.
Huh？ Do you have a cat, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
No. A stray cat often comes to the back door at Dixie's. Haven't you seen it？
Come to think of it, I see one sometimes when I take out the trash.
Near the back door there aren't many people around, and there's a sunny spot, so I think that's why.
Ah, come to think of it, there are cats there no matter the season.
Kuro-chan is the boss of the strays. It's small, but everyone defers to it, you know？
Huh... it must be really good at fighting.
I've never seen it fight... hehe, maybe I'll ask Kuro-chan next time.
Anegasaki
Oh right. Remember Kuro-chan？
The boss of the strays around Dixie's, right？ I saw it before too.
That cat was someone's pet.
Even though it's the boss of the strays？
Surprising, right？ I happened to see it going into a house near the restaurant with an old lady.
It was so cute. Playing around like a kitten.
Huh... even the boss gets cuddly with its owner.
I'd like to do that too.
Once in a while, I'd like to just cuddle up to someone to my heart's content...
Um... well. If I'll do...
...Hehe. I'll think about it a little, okay？
Anegasaki
Hey, are frog coin purses trendy lately？
Huh？ Frogs... you mean those clasp coin purses？
Yes. You know, they show up a lot in the lost and found lately, right？ Little clasp purses that only fit coins.
Come to think of it... but are they trendy？ I haven't heard.
They're not trendy in your year either？
Not with the guys, at least. The girls... who knows？ I'm not close with many girls.
...You're not？
Just enough to talk when we're in the same group in class... I guess？
Hmm... that's a little surprising.
Really？ With ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ around, that's just natural.
I see... yes, I know.
Anegasaki
People around me envy me for having a younger boyfriend, but...
What's this all of a sudden？
...To be honest, I'm still anxious. That someone might make a move on you.
No, no. Not at all. Even at work... ah, remember the frog purses？
The lost-and-found ones？
Yeah, those. Did you hear most of the owners were housewives？
Ah... yes. Come to think of it, you're really popular with the older ladies too, huh.
They're just toying with me... don't I get toyed with more than hit on？
...Yes. I kind of get that.
Besides, I love ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so it doesn't matter who makes a move on me.
...Hehe. When you put it like that, I have no choice but to be convinced. No fair, geez.
